decision.purpose: Isolate candidate-score supervision weight 0.1 versus 0.5 after observing large selected-minus-oracle error; retain model, loss formula, dataset, seed and optimizer budget.
decision.candidate_screen: Selected ADE and FDE must improve in all three paired seeds; selected geometry pass count must not fall and speed MAE must not rise more than 5% in any pair.
decision.diagnostic: Measure oracle ADE and selection regret separately; changing a preferred candidate index does not prove better selection or safe driving.
decision.test_policy: Val development only. Never evaluate or select on held-out Town04 test during this campaign.
decision.promotion: No automatic promotion, actuation, or independent safety-gate weakening. Preserve every unsuccessful result.
